body_text:
A complex power series centered at $z_0$ is an expression
$\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}a_n(z-z_0)^n$. There is a radius
$R\in[0,\infty]$ such that the series converges absolutely for
$|z-z_0|<R$ and diverges for $|z-z_0|>R$. On every closed disk
of radius less than $R$, convergence is uniform, so the sum may
be differentiated and integrated term by term.
